name: Lottie
tagline: LottieFiles is an ecosystem for Lottie animations — lightweight, JSON-based vector animations that play at any resolution without file bloat. Designers create animations in After Effects and export them via the Bodymovin plugin, then share or embed them with a single link. Product teams and web developers use LottieFiles to add smooth, performant micro-animations to apps and websites.
